summary: The United States Geological Survey offered no substantive comment on the draft environmental impact statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 regarding off-road vehicle use on public lands. Their entire response was a brief memorandum stating they had no comment on the document referred to them for review.

statement.text:
United States Department of the Interior
GEOLOGICAL SURVEY WASHINGTON, D.C. 20242
June 29, 1972
32
K14
Memorandum
To:
Director, Bureau of Outdoor Recreation
Through Assistant Secretary--Mineral Resources
From:
Director, Geological Survey
Subject:
Draft environmental statement for the proposed
implementation of Executive Order 11644
We have no comment on the subject draft environmental statement which was referred to us for review by your memorandum of June 1.
Director
